mapper.select: SELECT program.source_program_id, program.source_url, program.source_sort_timestamp, COALESCE(extraction.attempt_count, 0) AS attempt_count FROM support_program program LEFT JOIN support_program_period_extraction extraction ON extraction.source_code = program.source_code AND extraction.source_program_id = program.source_program_id WHERE program.source_code = #{sourceCode} AND program.is_source_present = TRUE AND (extraction.source_program_id IS NULL OR extraction.extractor_version <> #{extractorVersion} OR extraction.next_check_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY program.source_sort_timestamp DESC, program.source_program_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT source_code, source_program_id, status, application_start_date, application_end_date, evidence_text, reason_code, extractor_version, attempt_count, checked_at, next_check_at FROM support_program_period_extraction WHERE source_code = #{sourceCode} AND status = 'EXTRACTED' AND extractor_version = #{extractorVersion}

SELECT extraction.source_code, extraction.source_program_id, extraction.status, extraction.application_start_date, extraction.application_end_date, extraction.evidence_text, extraction.reason_code, extraction.extractor_version, extraction.attempt_count, extraction.checked_at, extraction.next_check_at FROM support_program_period_extraction extraction JOIN support_program program ON program.source_code = extraction.source_code AND program.source_program_id = extraction.source_program_id WHERE extraction.source_code = #{sourceCode} AND extraction.status = 'EXTRACTED' AND extraction.extractor_version = #{extractorVersion} AND program.is_source_present = TRUE AND (NOT (program.application_end_date <=> extraction.application_end_date) OR NOT (program.application_start_date <=> extraction.application_start_date)) ORDER BY extraction.source_program_id LIMIT 500
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO support_program_period_extraction (source_code, source_program_id, status, application_start_date, application_end_date, evidence_text, reason_code, extractor_version, attempt_count, checked_at, next_check_at) VALUES (#{sourceCode}, #{sourceProgramId}, #{status}, #{applicationStartDate}, #{applicationEndDate}, #{evidenceText}, #{reasonCode}, #{extractorVersion}, #{attemptCount}, #{checkedAt}, #{nextCheckAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = VALUES(status), application_start_date = VALUES(application_start_date), application_end_date = VALUES(application_end_date), evidence_text = VALUES(evidence_text), reason_code = VALUES(reason_code), extractor_version = VALUES(extractor_version), attempt_count = VALUES(attempt_count), checked_at = VALUES(checked_at), next_check_at = VALUES(next_check_at)
